items.claim: Bogdan Guskov won the second round decisively, potentially as a 10-8, but lost the first and third rounds.
items.quote: Bogdan did have a very good second round. He lost the first, he lost the third, almost had a finish in the second. Call it a 10-8

items.claim: Over the course of a 15-minute fight, Bogdan Guskov lost 12 of the minutes against Jan Błachowicz.
items.quote: he lost 12 of the 15 minutes. And that is to a former world champion in Jan Błachowicz

items.claim: Jan Błachowicz is an older fighter at this stage of his career.
Bogdan Guskov was losing the striking exchanges against Jan Błachowicz.
items.quote: he was losing the striking exchanges.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev suffered a knockout loss to Alex Pereira while fighting injured.
items.quote: Ankalaev got knocked out by Alex Pereira while injured.
